column1: Hanging Out With the Dream King|2004|10|10||7,5.5,5.5,5,6,7.5,3.5,7.5,6.5,6.5|Joseph McCabe|Nonfiction interviews, not Gaiman fiction or a comics craft course. https://comics.lib.msu.edu/rri/frri/fantagr.htm records 2004 and 297 pages; some on-sale records/source use 2005, so original year confidence moderate. Source 259 describes pencil/ink/color/editing divisions and coordination conflicts, providing transferable creative-production lessons. D=6 moderate reader-report estimate: different collaborators expose workflow constraints, much brief biography and name-dropping contributes less. T11 media personalities and T12 media industry. H13=0 interview collection rather than a single-period historical argument.

Theological Incorrectness|2004|0|10||7,6,6,6.5,5,8,3.5,8,6.5,7|D. Jason Slone|Analytical cognitive account of religion, not doctrine or proselytism. https://academic.oup.com/book/2458 and publisher preview https://api.pageplace.de/preview/DT0400.9780198044284_A23606322/preview-9780198044284_A23606322.pdf verify 2004, not 2007 paperback. Source 259 reports useful distinctions between stated theology and intuitive cognition but substantial introductory history with little payoff. D=5 moderate reader-report confidence: Buddhist reform and cognitive mismatch add knowledge, initial chapters are lower-yield. E discounts broad cognitive explanations without claiming all are disproved. T12 philosophy/religion; T11/H13=0.

The Secret History of the Mongols|1240|10|10|1240|5.5,4.5,3,3,4.5,9,4,7.5,5.5,6.5|Anonymous; Igor de Rachewiltz, translator|Counterfactual V3 moderate: historical epic chronicle, not automatically fiction because it contains legendary speeches. Source 259 read the 2015 shorter English edition and finds names, genealogy and narration dominate over explanation. https://sourcebooks.web.fordham.edu/basis/The%20Secret%20History%20of%20the%20Mongols_%20A%20Mongolian%20Epic%20Chronicle%20of.pdf verifies the translation identity. Conventional composition about 1240, low confidence, not translation year; the text's dating is disputed. D=4.5 moderate reader-report confidence: some organizational observations but extensive local narration. T11 Mongol history and T12 conquest/power; approximate endpoint 1240. Reject unrelated catalog author The Arth Estate.

Modern Japanese Diaries|1995|10|0|1920|8.5,6.5,5.5,5.5,6.5,9,4.5,9.5,7.5,8|Donald Keene|Historical commentary and selected diaries, not a specialist reference index. https://cup.columbia.edu/book/modern-japanese-diaries/9780231114431/ establishes coverage 1860–1920; https://www.kirkusreviews.com/book-reviews/donald-keene/modern-japanese-diaries/ confirms original 1995, not 1999 reprint. Source 259 values overseas encounters and institutional learning but finds some domestic literary diaries less useful. D=6.5 moderate reader-report confidence: mismatched expectations and comparative modernization add learning; personal episodes vary in yield. T11 Japanese social history; T12=0. Endpoint 1920.

Travelers of 100 Ages|1984|10|0|1850|8.5,5.5,4.5,5,7,9,2.5,9.5,7.5,8|Donald Keene|Analytical historical guide to diaries, not a purely chronological index. Author center https://www.donaldkeenecenter.jp/major-works/ identifies initial Japanese two-volume edition 1984 and English 1989; translation does not reset age. Source 259 describes commentary explaining unfamiliar lives across pre-Meiji Japan. D=7 low-confidence reader-comparison estimate: social contexts and changing diary conventions add learning; personal detail often has narrow utility. T11 Japanese history; T12=0. Approximate endpoint 1850 for premodern selection, low confidence. https://openlibrary.org/books/OL380508M/Travelers_of_a_hundred_ages documents 1999 edition, 468 pages, references 443–449.

Pillow book of Sei Shonagon|1002|10|0|1002|6.5,3,2.5,2.5,4.5,9,1.5,8,6.5,8|Sei Shōnagon|Counterfactual V3 moderate: nonfiction court journal, lists and reflections rather than Murasaki's fictional romance. https://oer.uinsyahada.ac.id/files/original/bc171eadade6acb82808632b1ced6f26.pdf supplies representative translated passages and conventional date 1002; composition date approximate, low confidence. Observations reveal etiquette and sensibility, but most value depends on local particulars rather than sustained transferable mechanisms. D=4.5 low-confidence sample estimate: differing social conventions add learning, many lists remain aesthetic or personal. English Morris edition identified in source/cached catalog. T11 Japanese court history, endpoint about 1002; T12=0.

Indiscrete Thoughts|1997|0|10||7.5,6,7.5,6,5.5,9,8.5,9.5,6,7|Gian-Carlo Rota|Reflective mathematics memoir/essays, not technical mathematical training. https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-0-8176-4781-0 confirms 1997; https://www.cut-the-knot.org/books/indiscrete/content.shtml provides contents. Source 259 finds valuable professional heuristics and Ulam/Gibbs cases amid gossip and opaque phenomenology. D=5.5 moderate reader-report confidence across the whole collection, not only the best essays. E discounts personal recollections and polemic; mathematical biography exception also supports eligibility. T12 philosophy is substantial and central alongside memoir; T11/H13=0 multi-topic collection.

Confusion of Confusions|1688|0|10||7,6.5,6.5,6,6.5,9,5.5,8,6,7|Joseph de la Vega|Nonfiction stock-market explanation in rhetorical dialogue, not a fictional plot or specialist trading-procedure manual. Source 259 explicitly identifies 1688 and Dutch exchange practices. Representative English text https://publiconsulting.com/spanishclassicbooks/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Confusion-of-Confusions-by-Jose-de-la-Vega-1688.pdf explains settlement pressure, incentives and speculative behavior while acknowledging gaps. D=6.5 low-confidence sample estimate: market practices add mechanisms, allegorical digressions reduce yield. T12 finance; T11=0 market mechanism rather than isolated national history. H13=0 contemporary explanatory account, not retrospective history of a specified period.

Robert Bakewell and the Longhorn Breed of Cattle|1995|10|0|1990|7,6,6.5,6,5,8.5,7.5,7.5,5.5,6.5|Pat Stanley|Historical biography and breed history, not a breeding procedures manual. Original pages https://gwern.net/doc/genetics/selection/artificial/1995-stanley-robertbakewellandthelonghornbreedofcattle.pdf and https://obnb.uk/p8793766-robert-bakewell-and-the-longhorn-breed-of-cattle confirm 1995. Source 259 reports useful innovation and business details in the first half, then long auction and pedigree accounts. D=5 moderate reader-report estimate across both halves. E discounts enthusiastic attribution of gains to Bakewell without independent controls. T11 English breed history, T12=0 agricultural production. Approximate late-twentieth-century endpoint 1990, low confidence; do not stop the period at Bakewell's death when half the book follows later developments.

The City of Falling Angels|2005|10|0|2003|7,4,3,3,5,7.5,1.5,7.5,8,8|John Berendt|Counterfactual V3 moderate: reportage, not fiction, but the main payload is Venetian personalities, feuds and local events. Source 259 recognizes careful handling of gossip yet little general explanation; https://www.publishersweekly.com/9781594200588 corroborates the digressive portrait structure. D=5 moderate review confidence: unfamiliar institutions add some history, loose personal stories dominate. Original 2005 cached OL3524941W. T11 urban history, T12=0. Approximate endpoint 2003 for La Fenice reconstruction, low confidence; do not repeat the review's erroneous 1997 fire date.

The Autobiography Of Benvenuto Cellini|1563|0|0|1562|5.5,5.5,5,5,5.5,9,4.5,8,7.5,7|Benvenuto Cellini|Retain with low confidence: first-person artistic production, casting problems and patronage constraints provide some transferable payload despite boastful violence and unreliable self-presentation. Source 259 explicitly questions exaggeration and supernatural episodes; those are not accepted as facts. First printed 1728; composition conventionally about 1558–1563, use approximate 1563 with low confidence, not 1946 reprint. https://www.pbfa.org/storage/catalogues/2511/82dc6e8f7f0d36310eea549609165677.pdf identifies original printing but gives a somewhat later composition endpoint, so date uncertainty is retained. D=5.5 moderate reader-report estimate: workshop constraints add learning, repeated feuds reduce yield. T11/T12=0 art/craft career across courts, not predominantly national history or political power. Endpoint about 1562.

Clever Hans|1907|0|0|1904|9,6,8.5,9,7.5,9.5,8,9,6.5,8.5|Oskar Pfungst|Historical explanation of a discovery and controlled tests, not a general experimental-methods course. Source 259 describes cue isolation, owner confirmation bias and instrumented motion tracing. https://openlibrary.org/books/OL18821050M/Clever_Hans_%28the_horse_of_Mr._Von_Osten%29 identifies German 1907, English 1911 and 1998 reprint with 267–274 bibliography. D=7.5 moderate reader-report confidence: distinct controls and observer mechanisms add learning; fussy detail sometimes lowers yield. T11/T12=0; approximate main investigation endpoint 1904, low confidence. https://wellcomecollection.org/works/w7kszn88 verifies 1911 total 274 pages; paired with reprint reference range is an estimated cross-edition ratio.

The Hye Ch’O Diary: Memoir of the Pilgrimage to the Five Regions of India|728|0|0|727|7,3.5,2.5,2.5,4.5,9,2,7.5,4.5,5.5|Hyecho|Counterfactual V3 moderate: historical travel record, not doctrine simply because its author was a monk and not a technical reference merely because it resembles a gazetteer. Source 259 describes largely local food, routes and religious patronage observations, with little explanatory development. 1980 English edition cached OL5460507W; scholarly introduction reproduced at https://www.scribd.com/document/1047906587/The-Hye-Cho-Diary-Memoir-of-the-Pilgrimage-to-the-Five-Regions-of-India-Compress places the journey's return in December 727. Approximate composition 728, low confidence, not translation year. D=4.5 moderate reader-report estimate: comparative customs add observations, fragmentary lists give little mechanism. T11/T12=0 multi-region journey. Endpoint 727.

Although of Course You End Up Becoming Yourself|2010|10|10|1996|7,4.5,4.5,4,4.5,7.5,2,7.5,6.5,7|David Lipsky|Retain with low confidence: nonfiction interviews contain ideas about attention, entertainment and creative work beyond personality details, though the source finds much of the content redundant. https://openlibrary.org/books/OL24226161M/Although_of_course_you_end_up_becoming_yourself confirms 2010 and five-day 1996 tour. D=4.5 moderate reader-report estimate: some working-process distinctions, extensive loose conversation and celebrity context. T11 media celebrity and T12 media/literary culture; endpoint 1996. No author-based veto or fiction classification from the interviewee's novels.

Chinese History in Economic Perspective|1992|10|0|1937|8.5,8,7,7.5,7,9,7,9,6,8|Thomas G. Rawski and Lillian M. Li, editors|Historical explanatory essays, not a curriculum in statistical methods. https://www.ucpress.edu/books/chinese-history-in-economic-perspective/hardcover and https://natlib.govt.nz/records/38115431 verify 1992, contents, 362 numbered pages and references 325–350. Source 259 finds market integration and demographic constraints informative despite specialist detail. D=7 moderate reader-report confidence: different regions, prices and labor arrangements add comparisons, technical minutiae narrow accessibility without automatically lowering density. T11 Chinese history; T12=0 markets and production beyond finance alone. Main case endpoint 1937 from listed chapters, low confidence.

Everything Bad Is Good for You|2005|10|10||5.5,6,5,4.5,5.5,6,5,7.5,8,6.5|Steven Johnson|Nontechnical argument about entertainment's cognitive demands, not a skills course. https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/everything-bad-is-good-for-you is a contemporaneous June 2005 author interview, correcting cached 2004; publisher paperback 2006 is later. Source 259 finds useful narrative-complexity diagrams but little empirical support for generalized cognitive improvement. E discounts moving from complexity to benefit; uncertain effect size is not here enough to establish V1 across the whole descriptive argument. D=5.5 moderate reader-report estimate: graph comparisons add distinctions, short broad argument remains thin. T11 American popular culture and T12 media. H13=0 general argument.

The Chicago World’s Fair of 1893|1980|10|0|1893|8,3.5,2.5,2.5,4,8.5,3.5,8,6.5,7|Stanley Appelbaum|Counterfactual V3 moderate: photographic historical record, not architecture training. Original 1980 cached OL5591795W and https://www.nypap.org/preservation-history/1893-worlds-columbian-exposition/ bibliography. Source 259 reports strong photographs but weak commentary and emphasis on prestige buildings over technological mechanisms. D=4 moderate reader-report estimate: visual comparisons add historical observations, little transferable explanation. T11 American urban history, T12=0; endpoint 1893.

The Cinema of George Lucas|2005|10|10|2005|6.5,6.5,5.5,5.5,6,8,6,8,8,7|Marcus Hearn|Nonfiction production/career survey, not the fictional films themselves or a film-making curriculum. https://search.worldcat.org/title/56405075 and https://books.google.com/books/about/The_Cinema_of_George_Lucas.html?id=sJQLAQAAMAAJ verify 2005, 264 pages and archive/interview access. Source 259 notes collaboration and writing processes but nearly absent critical appraisal. Retain limited production mechanisms; E discounts authorization bias. D=6 moderate reader-report estimate: production changes and workflow cases add learning, tribute and images often yield less explanation. T11 media celebrity and T12 media. Endpoint 2005, approximate final film coverage.

Solid Fool’s Gold|2011|10|0||7,5,6,5.5,5,7.5,3.5,8.5,7,7|Bill James|Question-driven nonfiction essays rather than sports coaching instruction. https://sabr.org/sabr-bookshelf/collection/spring-2011 verifies 2011 and identity. Source 259 dislikes the baseball emphasis but that preference is not a veto: operationalization, counterexamples and testing conventional beliefs offer transferable reasoning. D=5 low-confidence source-report estimate: varied statistical questions add learning, sports particulars and loose essays lower yield. T11 American-focused material; T12=0 sports is not itself an enumerated second thematic deduction. H13=0.

The Transparent Society|1998|0|10||7,8,8,7.5,7,8.5,8.5,8,8,7.5|David Brin|Nonfiction technology/policy argument, not doctrine, technical reference or partisan mobilization. Author https://www.davidbrin.com/transparentsociety.html confirms May 1998 and reciprocal-accountability thesis. Source 259's complaints about later blogging do not establish a flaw in this particular book. E discounts assuming symmetric observation yields symmetric power; retains useful incentives and surveillance tradeoffs. D=7 low-confidence description/sample estimate: privacy, oversight and information-access comparisons add mechanisms, some future scenarios yield less evidence. T12 power/policy central, T11=0 cross-society argument. H13=0.

Coming Apart: The State of White America|2012|10|0|2010|6,6.5,5.5,5.5,6.5,7.5,3.5,8,7.5,6.5|Charles Murray|Social-stratification argument, not a party recruitment text merely because it reaches policy conclusions. https://catalog.mercyhurst.edu/cgi-bin/koha/opac-ISBDdetail.pl?biblionumber=323782 and https://www.penguin.co.nz/books/coming-apart-9780307453440 verify original 2012 and scope 1960–2010. E discounts selection of composite class groups and causal inference from moral/cultural correlations; source only nominates it, so no claimed full-text verification or author-based veto. D=6.5 low-confidence contents estimate: different institutional indicators add information, recurring cultural framing potentially yields less. T11 American/racially delimited social history; T12=0 social structure rather than political campaigning. Endpoint 2010.

Conversations With Goethe|1836|0|10|1832|7,4.5,4.5,4,4.5,9,3.5,8.5,5.5,7.5|Johann Peter Eckermann|Retain with low confidence: recorded conversations on criticism, art and intellectual work offer general judgments beyond names, despite much social detail. Source 259 stopped early, so its negative report cannot establish whole-book absence of payload. https://obnb.uk/p9034945-conversations-with-goethe verifies original 1836–1848, use first volume 1836, not 1906 translation. D=4.5 low-confidence partial-report/catalog estimate: some aesthetic distinctions, many visitors and local allusions. T12 philosophy/literary criticism, T11=0 writer's fame alone is not media celebrity. Endpoint 1832 for conversations through Goethe's death.
